project_id.description: The GCP project ID for the project containing the BigQuery datasets to read from. Read more here.
project_id.title: Project ID

dataset_id.description: The BigQuery dataset to read tables and views from. Leave empty to discover every dataset of the project; setting it makes schema discovery much faster on projects with many datasets. Read more here.
dataset_id.title: Dataset ID

credentials_json.description: The contents of the JSON service account key. Check out the docs if you need help generating this key.
credentials_json.title: Service Account Key JSON

job_project_id.description: Optional. The GCP project ID where BigQuery query jobs are run. When set, the queries of a sync run against this project's quota and billing instead of the data project's. This isolates the concurrent query quota between workloads (e.g. data extraction vs. analytics) and allows reading from a project in which the service account only has data access. The service account must have the BigQuery Job User role on this project. If not set, jobs run in the data project (Project ID above).
job_project_id.title: Job Execution Project ID

max_db_connections.description: Maximum number of concurrent queries to the database. Leave empty to let Airbyte optimize performance.
max_db_connections.title: Max Concurrent Queries to Database

use_storage_read_api.description: Read tables through the BigQuery Storage Read API for high throughput (on by default). Requires the BigQuery Read Session User role (bigquery.readsessions.create, bigquery.readsessions.getData) on the project that runs the jobs; Storage Read API usage is billed separately from query bytes. When the permission is missing the connector falls back to the standard query API, which is much slower on large tables. Read more here.
use_storage_read_api.title: Use the BigQuery Storage Read API
